profile.headline: Front End Developer | Web Applications | UX Focused
profile.summary:
I build digital experiences that work.

I'm a web developer with 8+ years of experience building and improving web applications in enterprise and higher education environments. I specialize in front end architecture, performance optimization, accessibility, and leveraging AI driven tools to improve development efficiency and digital experience strategy.

I care about how things function, how they scale, and how they feel to the user. 

Over the years, I've led web initiatives, improved performance through analytics driven decisions, implemented accessibility standards, and helped cross functional teams move from idea to production with clarity and structure. 

I bring unique combination of technical depth and delivery discipline, with certifications in agile and project leadership that strengthen my ability to execute complex initiatives from concept to production. 

I am currently focused on advancing modern front end engineering practices and continuing to build high impact digital solutions.
